en.headline: Tuen Mun Road crash snarls Kowloon-bound traffic at rush hour
en.dek: A private car and a goods vehicle collided near the Tsing Tin Interchange about 8am; local reports said no one was injured and closed lanes reopened after 9am.
body: A Mercedes-Benz private car collided with a medium goods vehicle on Tuen Mun Road towards Kowloon near the Tsing Tin Interchange, close to Siu Hong station, at about 8am on Wednesday, police and local reports said.

Photographs circulated by traffic groups showed the private car spun so that its front faced the opposite direction and sat across a live lane, with tyre marks on the carriageway. Hong Kong 01 and Oriental Daily reported that nobody was injured. Some accounts said the goods vehicle left the scene and that officers were trying to trace it.

The Transport Department said part of the Kowloon-bound carriageway near the interchange remained closed for a time and advised drivers to use other roads. Queues stretched back towards Yuen Long Park and Castle Peak Road near Hung Tin Road, and Kowloon-bound bus and minibus services using the highway were delayed.
Star Headline reported that the closed lanes were reopened shortly after 9am and that traffic gradually returned to normal. Police said they were investigating the circumstances of the collision.

zh.headline: 屯門公路平治撼貨車 出九龍車龍一度延至元朗
zh.dek: 今早約8時青田交匯處附近私家車與中型貨車相撞，運輸署指部分行車線曾封閉，報道指無人受傷，9時後逐步回復。
body: 警方及本地媒體報道，今日早上約8時，屯門公路往九龍方向近青田交匯處、港鐵兆康站一帶，一輛平治私家車與一輛中型貨車相撞。
交通群組傳出的照片顯示，私家車車頭調轉，橫亂行車線，地面留有車胎痕。《香港01》及東網報道意外中無人受傷。部分報道指涉事貨車不顧而去，人員正追查下落。
運輸署宣布，屯門公路往九龍方向近青田交匯處部分行車線一度封閉，駕駛人士只可用餘下線道，並建議改用其他道路。車龍曾延至元朗公園及青山公路洪水橋段近洪天路，途經該路往九龍的巴士及小巴服務受阻。
《星島頭條》報道，行車線約9時許解封，交通陸續恢復。警方正調查意外經過。
